name: MLCB (Machine Learning Classifiers Benchmark)
description: Offers a benchmark suite of classifier evaluations to support selection and tuning of machine learning classifiers across datasets.
reputation: A specialized benchmark suite for classifier evaluation and selection; useful for systematic comparison but not as ubiquitously used as repositories like OpenML or UCI.
notes: Heterogeneous collection of datasets with widely varying difficulty, size, and class balance; non-LLM benchmark; results are highly dataset-dependent and prone to dataset-specific pitfalls (small-sample regimes, class imbalance).
